title: Wither Skeleton Tweaks
description: QoL features for dealing with Wither Skeletons
body:
# About

Wither Skeleton Tweaks makes farming and searching for wither skeletons a much easier task. Vanilla's method of farming skulls is frustrating at
best, and I believe I can do better.

## Wither Skull Fragments

Any wither skeleton that does not drop a Wither Skeleton Skull will drop a Wither Skull Fragment.

![](https://i.imgur.com/Dp9M5Ka.png)

## Skeleton Conversion

Any skeleton that spawns in the nether will be converted to a Wither Skeleton. They will retain their original weapons, so converted Skeletons will
have bows.

![](https://i.imgur.com/HRVJ0xG.png)

## Drop Cleanup

Damaged Stone Swords and Bows are removed from the drop tables of all skeleton-based creatures, including Wither Skeletons, Skeletons, and Strays.

## Immolation Blade

Wither Skeleton Tweaks also adds the Immolation Blade, a sword which causes instant death and beheading for all skeleton-based creatures.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/255902/description_a0f8025c-0586-41f6-ae85-04795db6f488.webp)
